scope: Read-only public-source audit; no curl, endpoint, service, binary, Cargo, proof, quote or live RPC execution.

trust_model.token_source: Locally generated 0x-prefixed 32-byte lowercase hex, or fixed non-production DEV_INSECURE token.
trust_model.command: Direct Command argv; -q first and -- endpoint delimiter; no shell.
trust_model.acceptance: Transport success does not bypass quote measurement/challenge, contributory DH, expiry, replay or proof/settlement checks. Production HOLD and DPCLK3 live-proving refusal unchanged.

selected_narrow_issue.confidence: High for missing source controls; runtime effects not executed here.
selected_narrow_issue.severity: Trusted operator configuration correctness / outbound action restriction; not remotely controlled critical SSRF.
facts: Three curl argv builders lack --globoff and HTTP(S) --proto allowlist.
-q and -- prevent configuration/option injection, not URL expansion or protocol selection.
selected_narrow_issue.precondition: Operator/deployment configuration supplies a glob-capable or non-HTTP URL; no public request or peer field currently selects the URL.
selected_narrow_issue.minimal_change: Add --globoff and --proto =http,https to all three builders, preserving -q first, -- URL delimiter, suffix/base contract, no-follow redirect and 401 behavior.
acceptance: Owned-loopback valid HTTP and schemeless HTTP remain accepted.
Glob URL cannot expand into multiple owned requests.
Non-HTTP source is refused without body/URL leaking into public diagnostics.
Both GET wrappers remain identical; three argv paths contain matching flags.
Only typed complete bounded 401 triggers exactly one existing re-handshake.
selected_narrow_issue.status: Proposal only; root owns implementation and native evidence.

remaining_scoped_candidates.source_fact: Literal /attest or /prove is appended after the complete configured base string.
remaining_scoped_candidates.impact: Suffix can belong to fragment/query rather than request path; trusted config misrouting/availability, not attestation bypass.

remaining_scoped_candidates.source_fact: curl Limits only bounds stdout/stderr/time; http_post_command has no body.len pre-spawn cap.
remaining_scoped_candidates.calibration: Individual user request limits do not bound accumulated/full-state witness. No remote OOM exploit demonstrated. A later post-serialization cap would not bound earlier postcard/seal/hex/JSON allocations. Response-sized 1/4MiB input cap is not justified.

remaining_scoped_candidates.source_fact: Generated bearer is in curl Authorization argv.

remaining_scoped_candidates.calibration: No peer-supplied CRLF bearer injection is reachable through the inspected handshake.

existing_tests.inspected: Shared 7 regular response/cleanup tests, gateway 8 response/status/resource tests, and prover_client flags/bearer/status tests; no explicit protocol/glob regression located. Previous passing runs are historical evidence, not a new execution.
